version: stage2-v1; explicit amendment before any real fitting
train: all 72475 official-train ECGs; inverse patient ECG-count weights
validation: all 4626 official validation patients; stopping, architecture/regularization selection, descriptive calibration and thresholds
amendments_to_stage1: User explicitly requests official validation for early stopping and thresholds: replace train-internal fit/stop/calibration roles for this version
Primary comparator becomes the selected standard ResNet rather than CNN for geometric comparisons
Six architecture/regularization candidates instead of Stage 1's fixed architecture with 2x3 LR/weight-decay grid
Microbatch 64, accumulation 1, common for future comparisons
Stage 1 files, sources and outputs remain unchanged
selection: highest validation AUC; ties within 1e-4 resolve by Brier then listed candidate index
optimizer: AdamW; gradient norm clipping 1; cosine LR from initial to 10% over 20 epochs
precision: float32 batches copied from read-only float64 mmap
normalization: retain delivered per-lead normalized values; no refiltering or learned rescaling
seed_streams: torch initialization seed; independent numpy epoch permutation stream
calibration: native risk is primary; calibration intercept/slope descriptive; cross-fitted validation sigmoid is secondary, with selection optimism retained
operating_points: 90% and 95% sensitivity and specificity targets on validation; thresholds frozen for future test; apparent and cross-fitted validation threshold assessments labelled separately
intervals: paired patient-only and crossed patient-by-seed percentile intervals; conditional on selected/fitted models, not unbiased after validation selection
benchmark: published EchoNext-Mini AUROC 0.820 CI 0.809-0.831 is contextual test performance, never a paired validation comparator
geometric_training: not started until baseline freeze; prepare same population/validation roles, six-trial budgets, five seeds, architecture parameter cap and measured total-compute caps
compute_accounting: single-thread CPU process-time including setup, training, validation and checkpointing; wall time and RSS separately; future strict-compute caps fixed from frozen baseline
